svg.title: Haunts glass tab bar states
svg.desc: Tab bar in glass, reduce transparency, increase contrast and Android states.
svg.text: The tab bar in each state, over worst-case content
Beneath each bar: a black block, a white block (a photo thumbnail) and the apricot headline card, the colours that stress contrast most. Values from tools/glass.py and contrast.py.
Glass opacity: 0.80 light, 0.90 dark (minimum to pass). Worst case idle label: A 10.27 / 5.61, B 11.76 / 5.87 (need 4.5). Selected pill vs bar: A 6.17 / 3.13, B 11.76 / 5.87 (need 3.0).
Reduce Transparency and Android: opaque surface, labels are ordinary opaque pairs. Increase Contrast adds a 1.5 pt edge at 3:1 or better against page and cards.
